lora.target_modules: all-linear (vision tower, projector and language model)

common.actions: 4-D drone-frame (dx, dy, dz, dyaw) per step, K = 8 steps per answer, 256 bins per value on the last 256 vocabulary ids, range = 0.1/99.9 percentiles (data/action_stats_manifest_10shard.json)
common.prompt: Current State: {x,y,z,yaw_deg}, What action should the uav take to {instruction}?  (+ one 224x224 photo)
common.progress_line: 'Left +FF.F,+SS.S,+UU.U,+YYY' = metres forward, sideways, up and degrees of turn left to the flight's end, in the drone frame; 21 tokens, written before the 32 move tokens (phases 4-5)
common.hardware: 1x NVIDIA A10G 24 GB (AWS g5.2xlarge), about 6.2-6.8 s per update of 32 examples

phases.name: phase0_real10
phases.data: 10 real UAV-Flow shards: 1,987 train flights (site split, instruction sweep), mirror copies, both wordings
phases.outcome: adapter_s2500; closed loop nDTW 0.128 / success 38% (section 1, 10 of the report)

phases.name: phase1_real_plus_sim
phases.data: + UAV-Flow-Sim 9,941 flights (168 near-test flights excluded: data/uav_flow_sim_excluded.json)

phases.name: phase2_low_lr
phases.data: same; 504 simulator flights held out for validation (56 per motion type, data/sim_val_flights.json)
phases.schedule: cosine, peak lr 5e-5, early stop on simulator loss (patience 3)

phases.name: phase3_all_shards
phases.data: all 54 real shards (+21,795 flights: 18,430 train, 3,365 val; no instruction sweep on the new shards) + simulator
phases.schedule: cosine, peak lr 5e-4, warmup 3% of a planned 26,000

phases.name: phase4_progress_steady
phases.data: same + progress tokens (the 'Left' line before the moves)
phases.schedule: warmup-stable-decay: steady lr 1.142e-4 (the cosine value at 18,000, no new warmup); plateau rule on real accuracy (D176), real + simulator accuracy from 26,000 (D177)

phases.name: phase5_decay
phases.outcome: adapter_s31000 (FINAL): line 61%; line + memory + deadband 69% / nDTW 0.449
